cohort: Women aged 17-25 years who conceived by IVF with an ongoing singleton pregnancy, compared to a control group of women in the same age group with spontaneous conception.
finding: Young women who conceived by IVF had a higher rate of labor induction, meconium-stained amniotic fluid, prolonged second stage of labor, operative vaginal delivery, and neonates with low umbilical artery pH compared to those who conceived spontaneously.
mod_finding: Spontaneous onset of labor was positively associated with spontaneous vaginal delivery, while prolonged second stage of labor was negatively associated with spontaneous vaginal delivery.
